## Pass-2 machinery findings (recorded, owed to named owners)

- **`exec_backend_hello_clobber` (distinct defect — the
  `unknown{executor_error}` root cause):** `hh-helper`'s
  `Hello{policy}` re-derives `srv.backend = "seatbelt"` whenever the
  hello carries a policy and seatbelt is available, silently
  discarding the spawned `--backend podman`. Every contained exec on
  this host therefore ran host-side under seatbelt — the `/work`-rooted
  write failed ENOENT → `ToolError{ExecutorError}` →
  `Unknown{executor_error}`. Verbatim journaled stderr captured; the
  session's hello reply itself reports `backend:"seatbelt"`. Earlier
  "podman lane" exec evidence predates any real policy-attached
  container exec (podman arrived at GATE-G11).
- **`probe_verb_enoent` (GATE-G11 carried — mechanism narrowed):**
  `probe()` fails inside `HelperClient::connect`'s `/bin/true`
  placeholder-child spawn (this host has `/usr/bin/true`, no
  `/bin/true`) — the helper's journal is never reached.

Both stay unresolved — honest inconclusive legs are the designed
output, never forced to `observed:applied`; the repairs are named
machinery debts, not R5.43 scope.
